successCriteria.note: Agents and folder defaults live in app.sqlite (DM-249, DM-250, DM-258). The upgrade import and the removal of agents.json were verified in sprint 1 (DM-248). DM-303's v2 migration adds a column and keeps every row (appDatabase tests).

DM-298 c1, c2 and c12, with no override. Find connects a8s as Autonomous Signed in, New chat offers it with its model list, and a Haiku chat answers. Approvals (Deny, then Allow), resume after a restart, and the dm CLI reporting the canonical folder all work.

Sprint 2's DM-255 (c3, c4, c6, c7, c20) and DM-298 (c5, c6, c7): custom CLIs are stored only after the native confirmation and a passing handshake. They are offered in the sidebar, New chat and Start run, labelled with the reported agent name, and stored at the link path the person picked. A script that exits is refused.

Sprint 2's DM-255 c5 and c7 and DM-262: the default is stored in app.sqlite, preselected by New chat and Start run, and cleared when the CLI is removed or the folder is untracked. Sprint 3 left this code unchanged, and its tests pass in DM-298's run.

DM-255 c3, c11, c12 and c13 (canonical cwd; moved, symlink-swapped and untracked folders are refused) and DM-298 c12 (Autonomous's dm reports /private/tmp/dm298/repos/s2). DM-300 and DM-307 changed only the listing folder and sign-in detection.

The renderer can't send a path: addCustomAgent refuses executablePath (DM-255 c4), and the program comes only from main's native dialog, now with noResolveAliases (DM-304). Arguments are validated in main and passed without a shell (DM-260, which had an independent security review; DM-257 tests).

outcome.summary: The epic is complete on agent-clis (027f042, bc01afd, c4a8aaf). Agents and folder defaults are stored in app.sqlite. Autonomous is a built-in agent that works end to end on this machine with no override. Custom CLIs for ACP, Codex app-server and Claude Code SDK are added with main-side validation, a native confirmation and a handshake. Each folder has a default CLI, and every chat is pinned to its canonical folder. Sprint 3 also designed the next step, chats as terminal panes in the app's main window. The branch is not merged into main or pushed.

title: Agent CLIs: run Autonomous, Claude, Codex or a custom CLI in the app, stored in SQL and pinned to the folder
